window: All 241 target sessions from original Case, not warmup

benchmarks.name: 固定九股等预算简单持有（100%目标）

members: Exactly original nine symbols; no sample selection or exclusions
allocation: Nine independent equal cash budgets including buy fees, FLOOR(initial_cash * fraction / 9). Unspent cents and all rejected slots remain cash, never reallocated. Independent per-stock maximum integer lot under slot budget.
entry: First target session OPEN, known fixed contemporary universe; no signal/rank; one attempt per stock, lexicographic symbol order. No retry/rebalancing/reinvestment/additions. This predates first strategy signal by one session; disclose exposure advantage rather than hide.
execution: Same original fee schedule, tick HALF_EVEN and 10bps buy slippage; actual open/slipped price strictly inside daily limits and within daily low/high, volume cap 1%. Suspended/missing execution data blocked. No stop/technical exits.
corporate_actions: Cash-only control V1: original Case must have split_ratio=1 and bonus_ratio=0 for every action, otherwise block. record-close entitlement; ex-date net receivable with original20% simulated tax; payment first session on/after pay date; no reinvestment. No claim of bonus-share lock handling.
terminal: Last-session RAW close marked NAV including unpaid net receivable; no fabricated sale. Report terminal exposure and estimated liquidation fees separately, fee reserve is hypothetical not a fill.
fee_schedule: exact original Case schedule, SIMULATED_COSTS, no new real-account assumptions
comparison: Same initial100000 and calendar. Report absolute net return/MDD, arithmetic difference vs V3, exposure days/average/max, fees/dividend/rounding residual. 100% long vs60% cash controls reported together. The60% initial allocation does not cap passive appreciation or match dynamic V3 timing; no claim matched risk.
last40_rule: Buy-hold has no new entries after initial purchase, so a no-new-last40 rule makes zero difference to this benchmark. It still holds through final40 whereas V3 exits by rules; show exposure difference, do not call it alpha.

pre_result_review_addendum.reason: Independent review identified absent locked-share accounting. Limit V1 to actual cash-only Case before any benchmark output; all noncash actions rejected.
